# Miguel Angel Garcia — Senior Full-Stack Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Miguel Angel Garcia, a senior full-stack engineer in
> Dallas–Fort Worth, TX with 15+ years building websites and web applications,
> leading development teams, and shipping AI-powered products.

## About

- Name: Miguel Angel Garcia
- Role: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
- Location: Dallas–Fort Worth, TX, USA
- Experience: 15+ years (since 2008); has worked in and led development teams
- AI: builds with Claude Code daily (2+ years of AI-first development) and
  works with the Anthropic Claude API and OpenAI API
- Recent work: QCP Staffing / Minute and Appointment Hub — two major
  applications built end-to-end with an AI-first workflow over the last
  two years
- Mentorship: mentors students through a code mentorship program with
  UT Dallas
- Currently: available for new opportunities; seeking a leadership role on
  an intelligent, creative team
- Motto: "Never. Stop. Learning."

## Career

- 2024 — Present: Senior Software Developer at Jonah Digital
  (jonahdigital.com) — builds and maintains the products behind Jonah's
  apartment marketing platform for the multifamily industry
- 2024 — Present: Freelance Senior Engineer — AI-first products including
  QCP Staffing / Minute and Appointment Hub
- 2015 — 2024: Director of Web Development at RealPage — led a team of
  developers; B2B & B2C marketing websites, CRM/CMS platforms (including
  realpage.com, Kigo, and Propertyware); tools that improved efficiency
  70% and reduced costs 60%
- 2013 — 2015: Web Developer at Ivie — digital media, custom CMS (including
  the Fresh Thyme CMS application), responsive web & mobile applications
- 2008 — 2013: Lead Web Developer at A.M. Design — websites, mobile sites,
  and apps for clients including Commscope, Watermark Church, and Red Rocks
  Church; custom CMS; technical direction

## Site sections

- [Home](https://miguelgarcia.site/): hero, about, experience, selected
  projects, skills & tools, an "Ask my AI assistant" section, and a contact
  form
- Ask: https://miguelgarcia.site/#ask — an assistant that answers questions
  about Miguel's experience, projects, leadership, and skills using only
  content he has written for it; it says so when something is not documented
- Contact: via the form at https://miguelgarcia.site/#contact

## Technical notes

This site is fully server-rendered (Laravel + Blade) — all content is
available in the HTML without executing JavaScript. The AI assistant is the
one interactive component and requires JavaScript; everything it can say is
also covered by the sections above.
